replies.author: clerveu
replies.body:
As a lifelong horror fan I so get what you're doing here so zero judgement - I'm not saying you *need* this but... I feel like introducing multiplayer, especially in a way in which the killer could be taken out/punished by really skilled players will go a *long way* in curtailing a lot of the judgement and accusations this is inevitably going to draw lol. Also just smart from a marketing perspective, nothing goes viral like a good multiplayer party game, which this format could be killer for (pun intended). 

In general though I think this will be a much easier sell to a much broader group of dispositions if it's framed as "torture your friends" not "torture random female NPCs". But then also as a bonus there's an *oddly fleshed out* single player mode too!  

Great work, keep it up!

Idk where you go from here.   Ideas?
